We had this issue pop up yet again, and with the current increase in traffic I thought it might be a good time to discuss it. These are the guidelines that I plan on putting in the sidebar. Please give me your feedback on these guidelines! If there's something I should add, take out or if you think it shouldn't be added at all, please let me know! If this post doesn't get any traction, like last time, I will not include these changes. Thanks!

We want to be supportive of developers/youtubers/writers, but there is a right way to do things and a wrong way! Please follow the guidelines below before posting any of your own content.

Content Creator Guidelines:

  1. Do not spam the board with your content! Submitting your own Let’s Play or Blog once a week is fine, but more than that can be deleted by the moderator if it’s getting annoying.

  2. Do not link to anything that takes payment info. Submit a link to a YouTube video of your game or an article about your game. Do not link to any page where the game can be purchased, such as Steam or your own Website. If people like what they see they can find it on their own.

  3. Do not artificially UpVoat your posts. Brigading or suspected brigading of content will be deleted. Of course, it’s entirely possible for a moderator to be mistaken please appeal the moderator if you believe there has been a mistake.

  4. Please participate in the board other than just submitting your own content. If you are just coming here to sell us your wares, then you’re shilling! Moderators can delete your posts if you’re only posting your own content.

Good luck and thanks for submitting to the board!
Content Creator Guidelines 2nd Round: Please give me your feedback

Point 1 - I feel like high quality content should be encouraged, however quality is subjective so it's hard to give a proper guideline... Posting regular Lets Plays shouldn't be allowed, as it will clog up the sub pretty quickly and honestly we'd search for them if we wanted to see them... However if you spent three weeks in the Rockstar editor to replicate a movie/tv show then post that shit, I'd love to see it!

On this note I created /v/gameclips a few days ago, people are more than welcome to submit videos/gifs there as that's the sole purpose of that sub, a place for people to view clips and for it to act as a catalogue of clips for people who submit them.

Point 2 - I feel like this could go either way, I posted a link to the Steam store page for Banished a few days ago, I'm in no way affiliated with them but it was a great offer and the Steam page provides hundreds of reviews, videos and a lot more information than I could provide in a post... I feel like Voaters will upvoat/downvoat if they feel like it's spam or genuine, often I think we are a good judge of that.

Point 3 - I'd be super disappointed if people started to manipulate voats here, it's not worth the effort of working on two accounts. But I imagine it will still happen :(

Point 4 - I feel like 4 is the most important guideline, posting your own content is one thing, but if you want people to look at it then you have to give us more, talk to us and get involved, try and be part of this community. If a well respected member who contributes to a lot of discussions posted their video, I'm sure we'd be more than happy to check it out!

I'd like to add that I think we should remove posts by trolls, we had the Witcher vs Dragon Age guy a few days ago, now the feminist today.. Feeding them is what they want, a lot of people wont realize they are trolling and will respond to their posts. I'd rather them be removed before they cause a problem for members of this community.

Thanks for the feedback Magnar, I'll be revising these before I put them up and hopeful turn them into something that satisfies most people. As for the trolls, I personally enjoy a good troll post every now and again, but I see your point. I'll create another sticky about the issue soon.
